moa_focus.title: 🧬 B-Cell Depletion & CD19/CD20 Lineage Focus — Blinatumomab (Blincyto)
moa_focus.subtitle: Highlights CD19/B-cell receptor signaling, plasmablast/autoantibody depletion, and B-lineage hematologic & neuro-autoimmune cascades (NMOSD, IgG4-RD, Myasthenia Gravis, SLE, B-ALL/DLBCL).
